title: Starter owners receive Growth-only derived analytics through dashboard and AI context
description: An authenticated owner of an active Starter organization is authorized for their own business data but not every paid feature. GET /api/v1/dashboard returns SKU margin reporting, expense-inclusive nett KPIs and waste percentage without evaluating the subscription. Its monthly chart also includes opex. GET /api/v1/ai/context is an alternate direct delivery of expense-inclusive nett profit; POST /api/v1/ai/advisor builds the same context and, with RAG unset, returns it as forwardPayload. The /api aliases share these routes. This is paid-feature parity failure, not a staff-role bypass or access to another tenant. Expense-inclusive and waste numerical differentiation requires nonzero metrics; supplier-master access is a separate candidate.
claimed_root_cause: Derived analytics are assembled with organization/outlet identifiers but without a plan-aware feature projection. Billing's Growth entitlement is informational only, while dashboard and AI context compute and return premium outputs unconditionally.

trace.description: Authenticated Starter owner can request the dashboard; no Growth gate is installed.
Live planCode is available in request context, but authentication itself admits Starter.
Only organizationId, outletId and query are passed, discarding the available plan context.
Paid-sale lines yield per-menu price, COGS and gross-profit aggregates, without a plan predicate.
Returns nettProfitIdr, nettMarginPct, wastePct, monthly expense-inclusive profit and menuPerformance with marginPct for every plan.

evidence.description: Supplier master and SKU margin report are Growth features; Starter gets basic supplier string.
Starter nett KPI is revenue minus COGS; operating-expense-inclusive profit starts at Growth.
Starter basic COGS explicitly excludes waste percentage and ROP.
nettProfitIncludesOpex is false below Growth, establishing a source-visible sibling entitlement.
Unconditionally subtracts opex and calculates waste percentage; lines 66-75 calculate per-menu margin and lines 87-100 expose the results.
Monthly chart profit subtracts opex without knowing the plan, an additional copy requiring the same entitlement projection.
Direct /context response requires authentication but passes no plan to getAggregatedContext and returns the result.
Computes grossProfit minus opex and returns nettProfitIdr and nettMarginPct at lines 105-106 independent of plan.
Legacy advisor builds the unfiltered business context and returns it as forwardPayload at lines 39-43 if RAG is unset; no downstream RAG assumption is needed for /context.
Strongest relevant sibling control: planAllowsRop(ctx.planCode) suppresses Starter ROP, with no calculated reorder quantity when ROP is null.
Primary waste workflow independently enforces requirePlan('growth'); dashboard does not inherit that gate.
Opex and waste daily-metric fields default to zero. Reviewed expense creation does not populate them, so nonzero numeric impact is a validation dependency rather than an assumed fact.

blockers: No approved sandbox with network isolation, allowlisted environment, read-only target/toolchain, scratch-only writes and aggregate CPU/memory/PID/disk/time limits is available; target execution is prohibited.

No local HTTP/service result demonstrates Starter versus Growth output. Nonzero daily_metrics opex/waste producer or downgraded populated history is not established; a zero-only deployment would mask these two numerical effects, though the margin-report path uses paid sale lines directly.

validation_plan.local: Under a parent-approved bounded sandbox, use dummy Starter and Growth owner sessions and fixture paid sale lines with distinct price/COGS. Seed explicit dummy daily metrics with nonzero revenue, COGS, opex and waste to isolate projection behavior. Compare dashboard KPIs, chart, menuPerformance, /ai/context and unset-RAG /ai/advisor. Starter must retain revenue/COGS and gross-profit basics but not expense-inclusive nett, waste percentage or SKU margin-report outputs; Growth retains them. Assert /reports/stock has rop=null and reorderQty=0 for Starter, not a blanket denial of basic stock reporting. Mock or disable all external RAG calls.
validation_plan.deployment: Owner review only: identify the actual daily_metrics aggregation producer and whether nonzero opex/waste can exist for a Starter tenant, including downgrade behavior. Do not infer such a producer or billing transition from the response schema alone. No deployed probing is requested.

title: Starter owner can use Growth supplier-master CRUD
description: An active Starter organization owner can invoke supplier-master creation, retrieval, update and soft deletion despite PRD restricting Starter to a basic supplier string. The owner is deliberately selected so the role check succeeds legitimately; the missing boundary is paid entitlement, not role or tenant authorization. Separate supplier records and contact fields are a concrete capability beyond storing supplierName on an ingredient.
claimed_root_cause: Supplier routes enforce authentication and mutation roles but omit the independent Growth plan gate; services and repositories take only organizationId and cannot enforce the missing entitlement.

trace.description: Authenticated Starter owner passes authorize('owner', 'admin') and submits a named dummy supplier.
Validated supplier body and organizationId reach createSupplier without checking planCode.
Service delegates directly to repository and receives no subscription context.
Inserts tenant-bound supplier master with name and optional contact/notes fields, returns the record, and the route sends HTTP 201.

evidence.description: Starter supplier support is basic string; Growth and above receive supplier master.
Supplier router is mounted without an outer entitlement middleware, under both /api/v1 and /api.
Live Starter plan is loaded into context; authentication does not reject it.
Role authorization checks only allowedRoles; owner access here is legitimate but does not imply Growth entitlement.
Existing independent plan guard can reject below-Growth principals, but supplier routes do not invoke it.
Router uses only authenticate globally; GET routes are available and POST/PATCH/DELETE add roles but not a plan gate.
Creates separate master records with organizationId, name, phone, email and notes. Tenant filters on sibling CRUD prevent cross-tenant access but do not prevent Starter use.

blockers: No approved bounded sandbox is available, so persistent creation and subsequent readback with a dummy Starter owner have not been executed.

validation_plan.local: In a parent-approved isolated fixture with low resource limits, create dummy active Starter and Growth owner contexts. POST a supplier with name 'Fixture Supplier' and non-sensitive phone/email/notes, then read back that exact dummy ID. Current source predicts successful Starter creation; intended behavior is PLAN_REQUIRED without persistence for Starter and permitted tenant-scoped CRUD for Growth. Verify PATCH/DELETE and list/detail use the same entitlement policy while ordinary ingredient supplierName strings remain supported. No real credentials, production data or external calls.
